ycy tunnel
Manage trusted tunnel clients and tunnel definitions
Usage:
  ycy tunnel [flags]
Commands:
  connect	Connect a native trusted client to a Tunnel Control Plane
  server	Run the Tunnel Control Plane and supervised frps process
Flags:
  -h, --help	help for tunnel
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
